decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - The illumination of the sign hereby permitted shall be static and shall not be intermittent.

Condition : 3 - Informative: At the time of this decision the premises does not have formal consent for a chiropractic clinic (D1). The applicant is advised to establish either through a retrospective planning application or a certificate of lawfulness, whichever is appropriate, that the current use is permitted.

Condition : 4 - The proposed advertisement, due to its compatible scale, appearance and position would be compatible with the commercial appearance of the area, the character of the building, and would not harm the adjoining businesses or result in conditions harmful to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Installation of internally illuminated projecting sign
